title: fix(nix): prove Darwin packaging and guard Rust overlay drift (#1171, #1172)
intent: Prove packages.default builds and runs natively on Darwin (aarch64) and Linux (x86_64); remove invalid Darwin /usr/bin/ld fuse-ld pins; enforce repository rust-toolchain channel through locked rust-overlay with a focused Nix check and clear CI remediation; document CI-proven vs exposed systems and the rust-overlay refresh procedure. No flake.lock auto-mutation, no cache/release work.
proof_hooks: nix build + decapod system version on x86_64-linux
nix build + decapod system version on aarch64-darwin (CI macos-latest)
checks.rust-toolchain matches rust-toolchain.toml channel via locked overlay
stop_conditions: Do not mark Darwin supported without green native Darwin CI
Do not auto-update flake.lock in CI
Do not expand into #1173 #1176 #1177 #1178 or release packaging
